name: Chicken Filets With Pecan Or Walnut Crust
instructions: Put pecans and bread crumbs together in a food processor and and pulse a couple of times until mixture is finely ground and well mixed , empty on a plate
Lightly pound filets between two sheets of wax paper , moisten them with a dash of lemon juice and add salt to taste
Dredge filets on both sides in crumb - nut mixture , using the palm of your hand to pat it on , shake off excess
Heat coconut oil in a heavy skillet , add chicken and saute on both sides until nice and brown
Do not let the oil get too hot otherwise the nuts will turn bitter
In a small skillet heat apricot jam and soy sauce with the rest of the lemon juice , add grated ginger and chili flakes to taste
Divide chicken filets between 4 heated plates , garnish with lemon wedge and cilantro
